name: kip-rdf
description: D-67 deterministic RDF / linked-data ingestion (N-Triples). Given the text of a local .nt file, returns signed, reversible kip facts as an AcquisitionResult: IRIs are global eids verbatim, owl:sameAs becomes a reversible same_as edge (proj union-find), rdf:type sets the subject node kind (and stays a lossless edge), other IRI/blank predicates become edges (edgeKind = predicate IRI), and literals become node props (datatype/lang as adjacent props). Blank nodes are skolemized to a stable per-file namespace. Pure and total (INV-A1): reads only its input, authors nothing; malformed lines fail loud (N5) unless skipMalformed. Only runAcquisition writes.
